description: Implement the Header/Navbar and Hero section with full glassmorphism styling, scroll-based opacity changes, mobile hamburger menu, hero headline with gradient text, dual CTAs, floating gradient blobs with parallax, trust bar with client logos/stats, and scroll-triggered fade-in animations using Framer Motion.
steps: Implement src/components/Header.tsx: sticky navbar with glass background (backdrop-blur, semi-transparent bg), logo on left, nav links (Home, Services, Work, About, Contact) with smooth scroll to sections, pill-shaped 'Book a Call' CTA button with gradient fill on right. Add scroll listener that increases opacity/blur as user scrolls. Implement mobile hamburger menu with animated slide-in glass panel.

Implement src/components/Hero.tsx: Large bold headline (56-96px desktop) with gradient accent text, supporting subheadline in muted gray (#a1a1aa). Two CTAs - primary gradient pill button and secondary ghost/outline pill button. Floating gradient blob composition in background with parallax effect (move at different speed on scroll using framer-motion useScroll/useTransform). Trust bar below with stats like '50+ Projects Delivered', '100+ Happy Clients', '5+ Years Experience'.
Add shared animation variants/utilities: create src/utils/animations.ts with reusable Framer Motion variants for fade-in-up, fade-in-left, fade-in-right, stagger children, and scale-in animations.
Ensure prefers-reduced-motion is respected: wrap motion in a check or use Framer Motion's built-in reduced motion support.
Verify npm run build still passes after implementation
acceptance_criteria: Header is sticky with glassmorphism effect and becomes more opaque on scroll
Mobile hamburger menu toggles a glass panel with nav links
Hero has large gradient headline, two styled CTAs, floating blobs, and trust bar
Scroll animations work via Framer Motion
